# What this document is for

Two markers are written and both name the second index; no marker names the
first. The second index is placed at the first marker naming it, and the first
index, which no marker names, goes at the end of the document. The second
marker is a second marker for the index it names, which used to be dropped with
nothing said at all.

One term files in each: [Alpha]{.index} and
[Babbage]{.index index="authors"}.
